boundary: Three single-request mid-prefill cancellation checks (direct replica, nginx loopback, public tunnel), each with more than 712K tokens still pending; immediate same-path requests completed in 0.243, 0.389, and 0.906 seconds. One request per path, not a general proof over all disconnect shapes. Also: the 32 MiB ingress body cap (40 MiB returned 413), exact-route matching with negative suffix probes, the restart=unless-stopped reboot rehearsal (authenticated /ping in 96 seconds, real generation in 8 seconds), and the native /v1/responses route.
campaign: Deployment hardening checks: cancellation, body cap, routes, reboot

environment.gpu_visibility: replica A GPUs 0-3, replica B GPUs 4-7
environment.ingress: loopback nginx with session-affine consistent hash on x-claude-code-session-id

evidence_class: retained run records; bounded deployment checks, not throughput benchmarks
